name: PreviewSourceScopeConfiguration
read_consistency: one short LLD-01 read snapshot for existing Source Scope/configuration candidates plus one read-only external source probe performed outside DB transaction; preview carries exact probe/config fingerprint for ConfigureSourceScope revalidation
ordering: candidate existing Source Scopes by exact provider/account identity evidence first, then display_name casefold ASC, source_scope_id ASC
pagination: none; bounded candidate set <=20 by SourceScopeIdentityV1 matcher
rules: preview never creates Source Scope or starts processing
filesystem path is mutable configuration and never sufficient Source Scope identity
raw source path is accepted only in request body under mutation-grade auth and is not echoed into URL/audit/diagnostic output
